steps.description: 用户登录以获取后续操作权限
steps.guidance: 使用POST方法调用/v1/cl/user/login接口，传入必要的参数如timestamp和body中的用户名密码等信息，注意timestamp的有效期为10分钟。

input.name: body
input.description: 包含用户名和密码的对象

steps.description: List all DDoS attack flow template information
steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/list with GET method to retrieve a list of DDoS attack flow templates. This call requires a valid session_id and a timestamp, which should be a Unix timestamp not older than 10 minutes.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

output.name: response
output.description: Response object as defined by attackapi.AttackFlowListResponse

steps.description: Create or update DDoS attack flow template
steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/create to create a new DDoS attack flow template or update an existing one. The request must include a valid session ID and a timestamp that is within the last 10 minutes.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for creating or updating DDoS attack flow template

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response body containing the result of creating or updating DDoS attack flow template

steps.description: 验证新创建或更新后的DDoS攻击流量模板是否有效，确保其可以被正确应用。
steps.guidance: 调用 /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/check 接口以检查 DDoS 攻击流量模板的有效性。使用 POST 方法，并提供必要的查询参数 timestamp 和 session_id，以及请求体 body。注意时间戳的有效期为10分钟。

input.name: body
input.description: request body for checking the attack flow template

steps.description: Run a specified testcase with given session and timestamp
steps.guidance: The purpose of this step is to initiate the execution of a specific testcase. To do so, call the /v1/cl/testcase/run endpoint using the POST method. Ensure that the provided timestamp is a Unix timestamp valid for up to 10 minutes and that an allocated SESSION_ID is used. The request body should contain the necessary details about the testcase run as defined by testapi.TestcaseRunRequest.

input.name: body
input.description: Details about the testcase run, refer to testapi.TestcaseRunRequest for schema definition

output.name: response
output.description: Response object as defined by testapi.TestcaseRunResponse

steps.description: Search for the specified testcase statistics history
steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/stats/search to get the historical statistical data of a specific testcase. This step requires a valid session_id and a timestamp within the last 10 minutes.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body containing search criteria as defined by statsapi.StatsSearchRequest

output.name: response
output.description: Response object containing the searched statistics as defined by statsapi.StatsSearchResponse

steps.description: Stop a specified UDP flood attack testcase
steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/stop to stop a running UDP flood attack testcase. This step requires providing an allocated session id and a timestamp that is valid for 10 minutes.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for stopping the testcase

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/test/report/download/csv with POST method to download a CSV test report. The request should include a valid session_id and timestamp (valid for 10 minutes). The body of the request should contain the necessary details for generating the report.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body containing the details for the report generation, refer to #/definitions/reportapi.ReportCsvRequest for structure

output.name: response
output.description: The response object containing the generated report, refer to #/definitions/reportapi.ReportCsvResponse for structure

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/user/logout to safely log out the current user after completing all test steps. This API requires a valid session_id and a timestamp (valid for 10 minutes) as query parameters, and a request body conforming to alps.UserLogoutRequest.
